verdict.rationale: Airbyte's incremental sync and CDC log-position tracking imply some checkpointing between syncs, and the Connection Timeline exposes error/logs, but there is no explicit documentation of automatic retry on transient failures or mid-sync resume from checkpoint. A community report even describes needing a manual workaround ('tricked Airbyte into thinking it had done the first sync') to get a large sync to continue, suggesting resume-from-checkpoint isn't fully automatic in practice. missing for 10: explicit retry-on-transient-failure docs, mid-sync checkpoint/resume mechanism, independent confirmation it works reliably at scale.
